name: detent
description: Local-first application security model compiler. Holds authorization from slipping backward.
author: Ryan Hugo (https://github.com/ryan-hugo)

scripts.verify: npm run hygiene && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run evals
scripts.inspect:fixture: npm run build && node dist/cli.js inspect test/fixtures/next-basic
scripts.snapshot:fixture: npm run build && node dist/cli.js snapshot test/fixtures/next-basic --out test/fixtures/next-basic/.detent/model.json
scripts.report:fixture: npm run build && node dist/cli.js inspect test/fixtures/next-basic --html .detent/report.html
